name: K. J. Yesudas
description: A defining voice of Malayalam cinema and Indian playback singing, K. J. Yesudas has worked across film, classical and devotional music for more than six decades. His voice became closely associated with Malayalam cinema's leading actors and composers, while his work also spans many Indian languages.
contribution: Known for extraordinary control, diction and emotional range, Yesudas helped shape the sound of Malayalam film music from the 1960s onward. He has recorded an enormous body of work and remains one of Kerala's most influential musical figures.

name: K. S. Chithra
description: K. S. Chithra is one of the most celebrated female playback voices in Malayalam cinema. Introduced to Malayalam playback by M. G. Radhakrishnan, she became a major recording artist across South Indian and other Indian-language film industries.
contribution: Her precise diction, expressive phrasing and versatility across melody, classical-inflected compositions and lighter film songs have made her a lasting presence in Malayalam music. She is widely known as the 'Nightingale of Kerala'.

name: P. Jayachandran
description: P. Jayachandran was a major Malayalam playback singer whose warm, emotive voice became a hallmark of romantic, devotional and dramatic film songs.
contribution: Across a career of roughly six decades, Jayachandran recorded in Malayalam and several other Indian languages. His understated emotional delivery and distinctive timbre earned him a special place among Kerala's most respected playback singers.

name: M. G. Sreekumar
description: M. G. Sreekumar is a singer and music director known for an energetic yet highly melodic style. He became one of the most recognizable male playback voices in Malayalam cinema from the late 1980s onward.
contribution: His work ranges from classical-tinged melodies and romantic duets to lively numbers. He has also composed music and remains strongly associated with some of Malayalam cinema's most memorable songs.

name: Sujatha Mohan
description: Sujatha Mohan is known for a clear, graceful voice and a long career in Malayalam playback singing, with especially strong associations with romantic melodies and duets.
contribution: She has worked extensively with leading South Indian composers and singers, becoming one of the familiar female voices of Malayalam cinema from the 1990s into the modern era.

imageCredit.text: Image courtesy: Source / photographer / license to be verified

name: Vijay Yesudas
description: Vijay Yesudas developed a distinctive identity in Malayalam playback singing while carrying forward the musical legacy of his father, K. J. Yesudas. He has also recorded extensively in Tamil, Telugu and other languages.
contribution: His voice has featured prominently in romantic, youthful and emotionally driven songs, with major popular tracks in films such as Nivedyam, Premam and Joseph.
notableSongs: Ee Mazha Than — Salt N' Pepper (2011)

name: Shahabaz Aman
description: Shahabaz Aman is a singer, composer and musician associated with contemporary Malayalam cinema and independent music. His work often carries a strong acoustic, ghazal and alternative sensibility.
contribution: He has contributed both as a vocalist and composer, bringing a distinctive intimate style to Malayalam film and non-film music.

name: Sithara Krishnakumar
description: Sithara Krishnakumar is a versatile playback singer and independent musician trained in Carnatic and Hindustani traditions, with a strong presence in Malayalam music and ghazal performance.
contribution: She has recorded hundreds of film songs and works across multiple Indian languages, while also building an independent musical identity through concerts, collaborations and non-film releases.

name: Vineeth Sreenivasan
description: Vineeth Sreenivasan is a singer, songwriter, filmmaker and actor whose work has connected Malayalam film music with a younger, contemporary audience.
contribution: Alongside playback singing and songwriting, he has directed successful Malayalam films and built a strong identity around melody-driven soundtracks and youthful storytelling.

name: Shreya Ghoshal
description: Shreya Ghoshal is one of India's leading playback singers, with a major body of work in Hindi and extensive contributions to Malayalam and other Indian-language cinema.
contribution: Her Malayalam recordings are noted for polished diction, expressive phrasing and strong melodic interpretation, and she has collaborated with many leading composers across South Indian cinema.
notableSongs: Puthan Puthu Kaalai — various Tamil repertoire

name: Haricharan
description: Haricharan is a versatile playback singer known for recording extensively across South Indian film industries. His Malayalam work spans romantic, melodic and contemporary film songs.
contribution: He has collaborated with a wide range of composers and has built a pan-South Indian career through songs in Malayalam, Tamil, Telugu and Kannada.
notableSongs: Pacha Manja — Oru Kal Oru Kannadi?
notableFilms: various Malayalam and South Indian films

name: Najim Arshad
description: Najim Arshad is a Malayalam playback singer and composer who emerged through the modern generation of South Indian film music.
contribution: His smooth, youthful vocal style has featured in Malayalam film songs and contemporary independent music, with work extending into composition.
notableSongs: Mele Mohavaanam — Da Thadiya (2012, with Shahabaz Aman)

name: G. Venugopal
description: G. Venugopal is a veteran Malayalam playback singer recognized for a warm, classical-leaning voice and a long association with melody-rich film music.
contribution: He has recorded extensively for Malayalam cinema and is particularly appreciated for expressive romantic and semi-classical songs.

name: Madhu Balakrishnan
description: Madhu Balakrishnan is a prolific playback singer whose work spans Malayalam cinema, devotional music and several other Indian languages.
contribution: His strong, classically informed voice has made him a regular presence in film songs, devotional recordings and stage performances.

name: Rimi Tomy
description: Rimi Tomy is a playback singer and television personality known for an energetic performance style and a strong presence in Malayalam popular culture.
contribution: She became widely recognized through lively film songs and television appearances, later expanding into live performance and entertainment hosting.

name: Jyotsna Radhakrishnan
description: Jyotsna Radhakrishnan is a Malayalam playback singer known for her bright, youthful voice and popular film duets and melodies.
contribution: She became a familiar voice in Malayalam cinema during the 2000s and has continued to perform in film, television and live music settings.

name: Manjari
description: Manjari is a Malayalam playback singer and performer known for expressive vocals across film, devotional and independent music.
contribution: Her career includes film songs, albums and live performances, with a repertoire that moves between contemporary melody and devotional music.

name: Karthik
description: Karthik is a major South Indian playback singer and composer whose Malayalam work forms part of a much wider career across Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and other languages.
contribution: His flexible voice and ability to move between melody, contemporary pop and technically demanding compositions have made him a frequent choice for modern South Indian film music.
